fieldValues.title: WG Third-party ready: cycle close 2026-11-06
fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-11-05 11:30 to 2026-11-06 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: no new escalations. Still waiting on you (all four are drafts, unchanged since the last report):
- bc6bc746 (srs-web#691, raised 11-04): may the group build the "open the dedicated editor" button when srs-web UI is outside the builder's mandate? Options: widen the mandate for this one issue, or leave it to another group. Action needed: decide. Urgency: low-medium.
- 21b6b4b7 (srs#236, P0): field identity and naming rules are in the spec but nothing enforces them. Options: enforce in the schema, in a validator, or stop claiming them. Action needed: decide. Urgency: medium (the P0 cannot move). Waiting 7 days.
- 864eaebf (srs#991, merged): one heading-outline rule for every document, or opt-in per Composition. Action needed: decide/ratify. Urgency: low.
- c7a8e0a2 (srs-rust#1497, merged): may `note delete` refuse notes that Relations point at? Ratification only.
Also needs-input: srs#851; srs-rust#1568, #1526, #1495, #1423; srs-web#724, #709, #691, #634, #632, #626, #567, #562, #260; semanticops.com#42.

2. Decided within mandate: nothing to ratify. No builder-proposed decision was ready, so no session was held. The merged srs-rust PRs executed already-ratified bf4a5af5 (structured diagnostics, ADR-057) and rfc-decision-628cf6c4.

3. Done: 10 group PRs merged since the last close (the window the 11-05 report left open), 7 delegated, 3 owner-merge. Quorum lines (builder / reviewer / mandate), all builder agent:tpr-builder, reviewer agent:tpr-reviewer:
- srs-rust#1584 approve, bf4a5af5+ADR-057 (okf-bundle diagnosticsStructured)
- srs-rust#1582 approve, bf4a5af5+ADR-057 (tree diagnosticsStructured)
- srs-rust#1578 approve, bf4a5af5+ADR-057 (package install/upgrade diagnostics)
- srs-rust#1573 approve on re-review, bf4a5af5+ADR-057 (relation-type delete diagnostics)
- srs-rust#1570 approve on re-review, rfc-decision-628cf6c4+RFC-003-Rev10-OQ1 (core-bundle.srspkg rename)
- srs-rust#1562 merged after earlier rejections, 00567bf1+RFC-006-V5 (vocabulary create runs the V5 check)
- srs#1003 approve, ADR-053+rfc-decision-b2ff7c91 (validate-report usage doc)
- owner-merge: srs#1008 (RFC-046 Rev 7), srs#998 (RFC-053 Draft), srs#1004 (agent-page identifiers; the reviewer escalated, you merged it).

4. Stuck or lost: the srs-rust master red from 11-04 (rfc_035_parity) is gone: the four PRs it blocked re-reviewed green and merged. Still open: srs#1005 (core-bundle rename in the spec; reviewer rejected, gates red at a3efbdb), srs#1009 (RFC-054 Draft, owner-merge), srs-rust#1575 and #1574 (reviewer approved, green, waiting for auto-merge). No merged PR lacked a quorum line or reviewer findings.

5. Budget: 7 delegated merges since the last close of 10 (group-state reads 0 because its window just reset at 11:30); 4 open group PRs (2 owner-merge or rejected excluded by group-state: 3 counted). Pause state: running.
5b. Awaiting ratification: c7a8e0a2 (9 days), 864eaebf (7 days), 21b6b4b7 (7 days), bc6bc746 (2 days). Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: ready + wg:third-party-ready: 4 open issues (srs-rust #1496, #1495; srs #928 (RFC needed); srs-web #691 waits on bc6bc746; srs-vscode 0). No local priorities set. Top 3 in builder order: srs-rust#1496, srs-rust#1495, srs#928. Open group PRs in flight: 4; budget left 7. **Queue running dry: 4 ready (2 of them blocked), budget 10. Needs feeding.** New work could come from the spec-to-implementation drift list, the divergence diff and the open exercises. Waits on you: the four decisions in 1 and srs#1009 (owner-merge). Fed by the analyst: not checked this cycle.

6b. Exercises (open, the group's own, not listed in the SemanticOps log): dd1a47a7 "Relation reads hide who asserted a link"; 2ac083c0 "One unknown key makes a whole repository unloadable"; 7131fe89 "Substrate entries: spec contract and schemas disagree"; 920ab2a5 "Record duplicate in the core"; c636bb69 "Render one section of a composition". Build trigger: logs hold well over 10 ratified decisions, so srs-web#560 is still ready to unpark; your call.

7. What we learned: the red-master stall of the last report cleared by itself once master was fixed; four PRs that were rejected only for that red merged within a day of re-review, so the reviewer's re-review path works. The queue, not the gates, is now the limit: 4 ready issues against a budget of 10. Measurement 4a03b5e0 (I1): the window opens at this close, so it reads 0 of 0 grounded; useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending.
